races.race_label: United States Senate election in Virginia — R primary (VA, 2026-08-04)
races.notes: DATE VERIFICATION RESULT: the 2026-08-04 date is CORRECT and is not an error — Virginia's General Assembly passed HB 29 (signed 2026-02-20) moving the normally-June statewide primary to August 4, 2026, amid a mid-decade congressional redistricting push. This is confirmed by an official Virginia Dept. of Elections news release ('Primary Election Moved to August 4'). The primary had NOT yet occurred as of 2026-07-31 (today) per live-results pages showing 0% precincts reporting. There is no Democratic Senate primary — incumbent Mark Warner is unopposed after all Democratic challengers (Daniels, Eichelberger, Moran) withdrew, per the Virginia Dept. of Elections candidate-list page and Wikipedia.
races.verify_notes: elections.virginia.gov's candidate-list page confirms 'There will not be a U.S. Senate Democratic Primary' (i.e., Warner unopposed) but its fetched excerpt did not itself enumerate the Republican Senate field; the 3-candidate Republican roster (Mizusawa, Farington, Williams) is confirmed via the Republican Party of Virginia's own candidate-announcement press release plus independent news coverage (Virginia Mercury, Daily Signal, WSLS) all published in the days immediately before the still-upcoming Aug 4 primary, and by individual Ballotpedia candidate pages.
